commit_message: Make visual validation mut binding cfg-aware
pr_title: GameEngine: add authoring-tool visual validation scenario
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds an explicit Visual Validation scenario for modeless Editor authoring-tool windows.

- parses an optional `gameengine-visual-authoring-tool` marker in the trusted `pull_request_target` context
- accepts the scenario only with explicit `editor` or `both` capture targets
- passes the requested label through the validation script only for the Editor child process
- resolves the label dynamically from the exact PR head's `AuthoringTool::ALL` catalog
- opens the requested modeless window before the renderer-independent screenshot request
- documents that this validates tool startup state only; document-dependent UI still requires a separate explicit scenario
- keeps the Editor authoring-window binding mutable only in `visual-validation` builds

This is automation/visual-validation infrastructure and is intentionally isolated from ADR 0125 product changes. It must remain Draft and must not be merged automatically.

The existing trusted `main` visual workflow is requested below to exercise the changed PR-head Editor/script capture path. The new authoring-tool marker parsing itself remains production E2E unverified before merge because `pull_request_target` loads the workflow definition from `main`; this PR cannot safely prove its own new trusted workflow logic before review/merge.

<!-- gameengine-visual-validation: editor -->
